notes: "Open the slide thumbnails and choose GX5Z, the project map used in this walkthrough. Click its title on the canvas. The selection outline identifies the object, and the Inspector now describes that selected object. The fragments are enlarged actual Editor captures of the same page. To start with an empty page instead, use the plus control in the page sidebar. Selection does not save a content change."

designIntent.purpose: Teach page selection, object selection and the Inspector relationship.
keep: Keep actual interface pixels, source attribution and the demonstrated behavior.
Keep stable page identity, editable objects and the correct author watermark.
designIntent.requestedChange: Teach an actionable Editor workflow through clear pictures and a focused narrative.
